title: kissed vietnamese cheese casserole
description: a dense and cheesy vietnamese-inspired casserole perfect for a date-night dinner. this recipe combines the richness of cheddar cheese with the bold flavors of vietnamese ingredients.
instructions: in a blender or food processor, combine cauliflower, fish sauce, sugar, garlic, chili flakes, and black pepper. blend until smooth.
in a large skillet, melt 1 tablespoon of butter over medium heat. add the blended cauliflower mixture and cook until slightly thickened, about 5 minutes.
in a separate bowl, whisk together eggs and a pinch of salt. stir in the shredded cheddar cheese.
add the egg mixture to the skillet with the cauliflower mixture and stir until combined.
transfer the mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish and smooth the top.
bake for 25-30 minutes, or until the casserole is golden brown and set.
remove from the oven and let cool for 5 minutes before transferring to an ice bath to chill.
once chilled, use a spatula to carefully loosen the casserole from the baking dish and invert onto a serving plate.
serve immediately, garnished with additional cheddar cheese if desired.
